description: The stored medium risk check `k_02`, as the owner reads it from the history. Same fields as the analyze answer without `cached`.

body.redacted_text: Aprubado na ang loan mo na 5,000 PHP. I-download ang app: [URL]. Kapag hindi ka nagbayad sa loob ng 3 araw, ipapadala namin ang mga litrato mo sa lahat ng contacts mo.

trigger_phrases: ipapadala namin ang mga litrato mo sa lahat ng contacts mo

why_it_works.text: The message threatens to send your photos to everyone you know. Fear makes people pay quickly and tell nobody.
Three days is short on purpose. It stops you from asking a friend or checking the app first.

explainer.scammer_wants: They want you to install an app that reads your phone, and to pay back much more than you borrowed.
next_steps: Do not install the app or open the link.
Do not pay under threat. Keep the message as proof.
Tell a friend you trust, and use Warn other workers to report it.
